# 2 Baruch Chapter 48 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 48:3 — cosmological measuring terms

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "you-who-measured the-firmament by-a-span and-the-dust-of-the-earth in-a-vessel" |
| LOGOS | "you who measured the firmament by a span and the dust of the earth in a vessel" |
| PNEUMA | "You measured the sky by a hand's span and the dust of the earth in a jar" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Span' is the standard English term for the Syriac hand-measurement; 'vessel' preserves the more archaic resonance better than PNEUMA's 'jar'. This parallels Isaiah 40:12 closely.

---

## 48:13 — Israel's election titles

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "your-firstborn, your-only-begotten, and-your-beloved" |
| LOGOS | "your firstborn, your only-begotten, and your beloved" |
| PNEUMA | "your firstborn, your only-begotten, your beloved" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. All three translators agree on the three titles; minor punctuation variation only.

---

## 48:19 — prayer address word order

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "hear, O-LORD, my-prayer now!" |
| LOGOS | "hear, O Lord, my prayer now!" |
| PNEUMA | "Hear my prayer now, O Lord!" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac word order places the divine address before the object; LOGOS preserves this more faithfully than PNEUMA's inversion.

---

## 48:40 — divine incomprehensibility of space

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-heaven-itself is-too-small to-contain-you" |
| LOGOS | "the heaven itself is too small to contain you" |
| PNEUMA | "even the heavens cannot contain you" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA's plural 'heavens' lacks direct textual support; the singular form echoes 1 Kings 8:27.

---
